pr2_open: A real pull request from an agent. Git finds no conflict.
pr2_comment: The memory review reads it as graph facts. It names the contradiction and the path that proves it.
pr2_check: The required memory-review check fails, so main does not take this merge.
pr6: A correct pull request from another agent passes and can merge.
live_hero: The same review runs live in a web page. Nothing to install.
live_path: One service, two active databases. The contradiction is drawn as a path.
live_stale: A stale clone. Git merges it cleanly. The graph loses a note and its links.
live_memory: This is the shared memory on main. Every fact has a source and an author.
live_cypher: Ask it in Cypher. Relate runs inside the page as WebAssembly.
live_break: Now break it. Write a second port for checkout-web.
live_fail: The rules run again in the page and the review finds the contradiction.
